SOILTECH ASA (org.nr 996 819 884) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2011-03-24, registered 2011-04-13. Business address: Koppholen 25, 4313 SANDNES. Main industry (NACE): 39.000 Miljøutbedring, opprydding og lignende aktivitet. Registered employees: 28 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 400,891,000; operating result NOK 59,167,000; net result NOK 32,407,000; total assets NOK 582,808,000; equity NOK 247,060,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 400,986,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Jan Erik Tveteraas; board chair Dag Schjerven; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.soiltech.no. LEI: 529900E9W21TGMWZ7430 (ACTIVE).
